metadata.title: Urban Street Scene with Portrait Billboard

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban street scene featuring a large, warm-toned oil-painted portrait billboard as the central anchor. The scene is populated by figures in bright 1980s-era streetwear, set against a gritty, purple-toned brick wall and concrete sidewalk.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm orange-red billboard contrasts sharply with the cool purple-grey brick background.
The child jumping rope on the left balances the couple with the boombox on the right.
The painted portrait's gaze creates a secondary focal point that oversees the street activity.
coreInvariants: A large rectangular framed artwork mounted on a textured wall.
A color palette dominated by saturated purples, oranges, and yellows.
Urban street elements like a cellar door, bollard, and litter.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The billboard is centered and occupies the top-middle third of the frame. Human subjects are placed in the lower foreground at the left and right edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large oil-painted portrait within the golden frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the billboard, moves down to the jumping child, across the sidewalk to the couple, and up to the diagonal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured brick wall provides a neutral backdrop that allows the saturated subjects to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and grey (background walls and sidewalk).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and red (billboard interior and clothing accents).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects against a desaturated, medium-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean whites; use off-whites and grimy textures.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, condensed sans-serif and elegant serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display text is tilted at a 45-degree angle.
Main title uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Secondary text uses a blocky, slanted sans-serif with tight tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the slanted text are staggered vertically to create a 'bouncing' effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a classical serif for the name and a playful, energetic sans-serif for the phrase.

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the yellow text
High-contrast serif for the billboard name
avoid: Horizontal alignment for the yellow text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif feel of the billboard text.
Provides the heavy, condensed skeleton for the slanted yellow text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1980s urban street scene. In the center, a large framed oil painting of a woman's face in warm orange tones. To the left, a young girl in a purple tracksuit jumps rope. To the right, a man with a silver boombox on his shoulder walks with a woman in a pink and blue outfit. The background is a purple-tinted brick wall with a cellar door on the ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large serif name in red with a white outline across the top of the painting. Add a three-line phrase in bold yellow condensed sans-serif, tilted 45 degrees, to the right of the billboard.

verificationChecks: Is the billboard the largest visual element?
Is the yellow text slanted at a 45-degree angle?
Are the colors saturated and reminiscent of the 80s?
Is the background wall textured and purple-toned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple color cast
The specific fashion items on the subjects
The expression of the woman in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact graffiti tags on the wall
Proprietary logos on the boombox or clothing

mustAchieve: Dynamic composition with multiple human elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the billboard frame looks like a physical object on the wall.
Check that the jump rope has a motion blur or realistic arc.
Verify the yellow text has a slight drop shadow for legibility against the bricks.
Confirm the lighting on the subjects matches the ambient street light.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale framed artwork as a backdrop with candid street photography of figures in era-specific fashion, using a split-complementary color scheme of purple and orange.
